name: IT Helpdesk Overview
description: Metabase dashboard for IT Helpdesk Overview

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.it_tickets WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.it_tickets WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND sla_deadline < NOW()
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.it_tickets WHERE status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY priority
SELECT created_at::date as day, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.it_tickets WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
